title: AI-Powered Payroll Solution (AI Payroll Guard)
summary: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its live AI-enabled payroll system reduced processing time by up to 95%. AI's share of the wider automation gain is not isolated.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The UAE Ministry of Finance reports that its live federal payroll system reduced processing time by up to 95%. AI's share of the wider automation gain is unknown.
purpose: Automate payroll processing, validation, and exception handling.
deployer: UAE Ministry of Finance and federal entities

ratings.reason: The Ministry reports up to 95% less payroll-processing time. AI's share of the wider automation gain is unknown.
Timely, accurate salaries are intended. Changes in missed or erroneous payments are unmeasured.

ai_role.statement: AI is described as validating payroll data, detecting exceptions, and supporting the interface. Other automation also executes processing and payments, so AI's separate contribution is unknown.

evidence.citation: Project account in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. Outcomes are reported by the project team. The account provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 4: AI-Powered Payroll Solution (AI Payroll Guard)

produced_by: Conditions that could produce the benefit are unspecified.
must_hold: Payroll data validation and human approval checkpoints

headline: AI Payroll Guard cuts federal payroll processing time
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
